name: Alaproclate
metabolism: Human metabolism has not yet been verified for this entry. Responsible enzymes, metabolites and elimination routes are not specified. This is a documentation gap, not evidence that the substance is not metabolized; do not infer a pathway from related compounds.
summary: Alaproclate is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor developed as an antidepressant in the 1970s. Development was discontinued after liver complications were observed in rodent studies; it has also been reported to act as a non-competitive NMDA receptor antagonist.
